title: Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers Extension Fee: Payment Function Reference
content:
**Subject.** This page covers the extension fee on a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers, and the function through which the credit holder pays it by card.

## Condition

The extension fee is not worked out until every call-center redemption on the credit that owes a telephone fee carries its own linked telephone fee entry.

In the same terms: while a call-center redemption on the credit that owes a telephone fee has no linked telephone fee entry of its own, the extension fee is not yet worked out.

## Capability

The payment function books the holder's card payment as an extension fee entry on the credit, dated the day of payment, for the amount given. The credit's value, status and expiry date do not change. The holder sees the fee in the credit's fee history and receives the fee entry number as the payment receipt.

## How it is invoked

The function is `pay_credit_extension_fee_5a6cc7fd`. It belongs to the customer: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to pay.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `credit_id` | Reference number of the credit the fee is paid on, as the agent gives it to the holder from the credit lookup | identifier |
| `fee_amount` | The fee paid, in US dollars | non-negative amount with 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent on receipt |

## Return

A successful payment returns a receipt with:
- `status` — the word "fee_paid";
- `credit_id` — the credit the fee was paid on;
- `fee_entry_id` — reference number of the new fee entry, which is the payment receipt;
- `fee_type` — always "extension_fee";
- `fee_amount` — the amount paid, in US dollars with 2 decimal places;
- `entry_date` — the payment date, in the form YYYY-MM-DD.

## Receipt illustrated (hypothetical)

A payment made on 1 July 2026 with a fee amount of 45 produces an extension fee entry of 45.00 dated 2026-07-01, and the receipt shows fee type "extension_fee". The figures illustrate the contract only.
